name: precap
description: Write a grounded recap of a task as if it were already done, then use it to check whether a long-running agent is still on the imagined path.

interface.shortDescription: Recap the task before doing it
interface.longDescription: Investigate the repo, plan, and git state, write precap.md as the recap of the finished work, and check the running agent against it for drift.
defaultPrompt: Precap this task: investigate, then write precap.md.
